name: What causes water to leak through a ceiling?

mainEntity.name: What causes water to leak through a ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water leaks through a ceiling can stem from various issues, including roof damage like missing shingles or cracks, plumbing leaks from pipes within walls or above the ceiling, or overflowing bathtubs/toilets on an upper floor. HVAC condensation drain line blockages or appliance malfunctions, such as a water heater or washing machine, can also lead to leaks. Heavy rain, especially combined with poor drainage, can exacerbate these problems and cause water to penetrate the structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common causes include roof damage, plumbing leaks from pipes or fixtures, HVAC issues, and overflowing appliances. Heavy rain can worsen existing problems.
